periods.label: 独腕剑圣败于深海魔女
periods.occupation: Rebellion executive; assassin mentor; Akatsuki supervisor

status.current: defeated and incapacitated by Shizuku after trying to execute Alice's punishment
status.power_level: treated as A-rank-class by Alice's fear and by the operation

personality.summary: Severe, violent and ideological; believes strength is the only truth and love/morality are lies.

relationships.nagi-arisuin: Found Alice after the orphan tragedy, paid him one hundred million yen, trained him as Black Shadow Killer, and later punishes his betrayal.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Attempts to kill her in front of Alice, but is defeated when she evolves Water Rebirth.
relationships.edelweiss: Present at the same Akatsuki base; Ouma assumes her presence makes Ikki's route a dead end.

periods.summary: Wallenstein is the Rebellion Twelve Apostle who recruited the traumatized young Alice after the orphan massacre and taught him to accept a world where only strength matters. In the present he supervises Akatsuki's operation and asks whether Alice is prepared to neutralize Hagun. After Amane's foresight exposes Alice's defection, Wallenstein beats him in Akatsuki's underground training ground and tries to kill Shizuku in front of him. His friction manipulation makes attacks slide off and gives his sword absolute cutting power, but Shizuku's Water Rebirth bypasses his defenses from inside his lungs and body, leaving him defeated.

key_events.summary: Recruits Alice after giving him the mayor's head and paying his requested price.
Beats Alice for betraying Rebellion and Akatsuki.
Nearly kills Shizuku, then loses to her vapor-body counterattack.
